chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 609: The Prisoner’s Bargain — Ji Ning’s Golden Core Dilemma
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns his third-rate Golden Core can be upgraded—but the price is bringing a World God. Can he out-negotiate imprisoned Elder Gods and Ancestral Immortals?
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 609 – No Rabbit, No Hawk
og_description: The prisoners of the World Prison will not hand over their secrets without a World God. Ji Ning must find another angle.
twitter_title: Ji Ning tries to bargain with ancient immortals—and gets shut down hard. Ch. 609 of Desolate Era!
twitter_description: The prisoners want a World God in exchange for Golden Core upgrades. Ji Ning has to think fast.

lore_anchors.definition: A Chinese idiom meaning one will not act without a clear reward; used here to describe the prisoners' refusal to give Ji Ning secrets without seeing a World-level existence.
Unbreakable chains binding the prisoner's truesoul, not just their body; only a breakthrough to World God level can shatter them.
A precious liquid distilled from primal chaos, used as a key catalyst for soul-splitting clone techniques; the World Prison's grand formation extracts it from prisoners.
Three tiers: first-tier equals True Immortal vs True God; second-tier matches weakest True God; third-tier is utterly outclassed.
The ancient cosmic empire that built the World Prison, now said to have fallen.
Ji Ning's innate spirit treasure, used for fast travel across vast distances.
